title: Model DPMI INT 31h AX=0200 protected-mode vector query
description: Continue the original-byte -k DOS/4GW startup beyond the measured AX=0600 call. Implement the evidence-bounded AX=0200 Get Protected Mode Interrupt Vector contract with explicit configured vector state, correct register outputs and CF behavior; preserve unrelated register bits and trace unsupported/unseeded vector numbers rather than inventing handlers. Capture exact observed input registers from the native oracle, add unit tests for configured and unseeded vectors, then rerun the original-byte probe to the next startup gate.
acceptance: DPMI AX=0200 inputs at the measured guest site 0x001C8CD2 are recorded from target execution
Configured protected-mode vectors return selector:offset and clear CF according to DPMI semantics
Unconfigured vectors have a documented conservative result and unit coverage
Original-byte -k advances beyond 0x001C8CD2 or records the next precise blocker
The gate remains truthful about MENU, mission and gameplay
